shared_assumptions.traffic_scenario: assumed historical-context activity; evening flow = 0.6 × day and night flow = 0.2 × day
shared_assumptions.statement: Uncalibrated modeled exterior LAeq; not a measurement, current traffic observation, interior level, or quietness rating.
shared_assumptions.diffraction: horizontal edges (roofs, terrain) on; vertical edges (around building sides) off, per CNOSSOS-EU / Directive 2015/996 guidance for road sources
shared_assumptions.source_scenario: 852 corrected freeway + 583 corrected lower-road sources (1,435), shared by all 12 tiles
shared_assumptions.engine_threads_note: results are identical for 2 and 8 engine threads

identity.receiver_key: tile_id:source_RECEIVER_KEY; source numeric PK retained as provenance
identity.building_key: lariac:SOURCE_BLD_ID; physical building duplicates across tiles are merged by this key
identity.legacy_url: The existing model/building/receiver numeric hash parameters resolve to the r02-c03 tile. New links retain stable tile/source keys.

loading.strategy: load default tile first; fetch additional tiles only when the current map viewport intersects their WGS84 bounding box or a stable selection explicitly requests that tile
loading.tile_request_cache: one in-flight and one completed fetch per tile for the page lifetime
loading.partial_coverage_disclosure: Counts describe loaded tiles and update as the viewer pans.

admission.decision: Root approved exact three c02 public assets and combined-study behaviors after independent numeric, provenance, seam, saved-selection, height-disclosure, desktop, and mobile checks.
